purpose: Small-sample research-only sequential transition prototype while canonical exact-NY17 history is quota-blocked.

model.target: break on next governed observation conditional on current non-break origin

state_mapping.weakening_threshold: 75th percentile of training fitted hazard probabilities; no test labels used
state_mapping.BREAK_ALERT: second consecutive governed origin at or above weakening threshold
state_mapping.recovery: first governed origin below weakening threshold returns to STABLE
state_mapping.note: State mapping is exploratory and was created after the research smoke phase; it is not eligible for canonical or prospective claims without re-freeze and canonical rerun.
